verdict.rationale: Simular documents a Sai API covering the core loop: `POST /v1/agents/message`, approval handling via `POST /v1/agents/approve`, a Python SDK and the `@simular-ai/sai-mcp` MCP server. Saving replayable skills can also be done through task prompts. Nothing shows the API matches the UI, though: scheduling, computer management, marketplace workflows, skill sharing and BYOD setup appear only as UI features, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity, API endpoints for scheduling, computer/session management, skill and marketplace management, a published OpenAPI/reference spec, independent corroboration.
